3. **Fixed the price/currency separator**: The corrupted "\u221a\u2020" preceding the price was normalized to "à" (the common abbreviation used before a per-unit price in these adverts).

The rest of the structure (ITEM, BIBL, PRIZE) was already valid and retained.
